Deepti and I intersected through cross-team projects at NexGen, where she supported platform scaling initiatives. Her role as a Platform Engineer required her to balance operational reliability with innovation, and she consistently delivered under tight deadlines.  

Daily, Deepti managed AWS environments for multiple clients, ensuring seamless integration of third-party tools. She automated repetitive tasks using GitHub Actions, which reduced deployment errors by 30% in her team’s workflows. Her work with Infrastructure as Code streamlined provisioning, cutting setup time for new projects by roughly two days. She also championed cloud cost optimization, regularly auditing resource usage and identifying underutilized services that saved the team an estimated $12K monthly.  

A standout moment occurred when she redesigned a client’s Kubernetes cluster to improve scalability. By reconfiguring Terraform templates, she enabled dynamic scaling without manual intervention, which resolved a critical bottleneck. Her attention to detail and proactive approach to problem-solving were evident in her documentation, which became a go-to resource for teammates.  

Deepti’s reliability and collaborative mindset make her a valuable asset. She thrives in complex environments and approaches challenges with a calm, methodical perspective. I’d welcome the opportunity to see her contribute to your team’s goals.
